objective: Make a failed run-list refresh a visible, persistent unavailable state in the read-only Dashboard: the previous total, unfiltered count, page and page controls are cleared or labelled unavailable instead of continuing to describe the last successful response beside a locally filtered list.
decision_supported: Whether an operator can tell a request failure from a genuine zero-match filter on the run list, and whether a failed request leaves any stale count or page control that reads as the current selection's result.
acceptance: a failed page or filter request is visibly marked as unavailable rather than as a successful empty result
the previous total, unfiltered count, page and page controls are cleared or labelled stale while the selection is unresolved
a genuine zero-match successful response stays distinguishable from a request failure
the error message persists until retry or success and is exposed to assistive technology through an alert region
retrying a failed request restores a coherent list, count and pagination triple for the selection that failed
the regression tests drive the real app.js loadRuns state transition and assert the rendered count, list and pagination triples
the dashboard stays read-only: the retry re-issues the same GET run-list request and no write verb is added
evidence: pytest transcript for the two Dashboard test files with the passed count
before and after state triples for the successful page, the failed refresh and the retry, captured by driving the real loadRuns under a DOM and fetch stub
the failed-request screen text showing the unavailable run list, its alert role and the labelled pagination
the zero-match control reading 显示 0 / 0 with no unavailable marker, distinguishing it from the failure
node --check output for apps/dashboard/app.js and the final line of build/verify.sh
stop_conditions: a backend contract, API schema or error-code change is required
the UI cannot distinguish a response body from a transport failure, in which case the generic unavailable state is kept rather than inventing a reason
a modification outside allowed_paths is required
the change would introduce a write or control path, a runtime dependency or a Node package
data_classification: public repository source, documentation and committed scripted fixtures; no secrets, personal data or physical measurement data
model_policy: AI may write the run-list request state, its renderers, the styles and the regression tests; a named human Owner accepts the accessibility review of the unavailable state
risks_and_fallbacks: clearing the rendered rows on a failure removes a run the operator could still select; fallback is that the retry button repeats the exact filter and page that failed, and the previously loaded run detail is left untouched

the unavailable state could hide a genuinely empty filtered set; fallback is that a successful response always clears the failure flag and renders the zero-match summary, and a test asserts both readings differ
a toast already disappears after 3.2 s; fallback is that the persistent error lives in the run-list alert region rather than in the toast
rollback is a revert of this commit; the change is confined to the run-list refresh path and adds no API or schema surface
